newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up at mid-April.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up at mid-April.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $29.19 million in the first half of April to $6,350 million, according to central bank figures published on Thursday.
Gross reserves had risen by $30.71 million in the second half of March to $6,321.49 million.
Gross reserves include commercial banks' net foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.

The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves. They stood at $4,310 million at end of March. Net reserves were $4,280 million at the end of February. They stood at $4,015 million at the end of 1996 compared with $2,858 million a year earlier. They were $2,732 million at the end of 1994.
